content.question: What's the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning?
options: Supervised learning uses labeled data, while unsupervised - unlabeled.
Supervised learning finds hidden patterns in data, while unsupervised learning predicts predefined categories.
Supervised learning learns from rewards and penalties, while unsupervised learning learns from labels.
Supervised learning works only with text data, while unsupervised learning works only with images.
content.answer: Supervised learning uses labeled data, while unsupervised - unlabeled.
